recognize_zh: 中倍視野中巨核細胞數量增加並鬆散成群，核濃染、形狀扭曲，背景為纖維化基質，細胞呈流線狀排列並有出血與含鐵血黃素；在 PV 病史下符合 post-PV myelofibrosis。
features: Megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular and clumped nuclei; size variation
Fibrotic eosinophilic stroma with streaming of spindle cells and small hematopoietic cells
Granulocytic cells present; erythroid islands not prominent
Focal hemorrhage with hemosiderin and scattered fat spaces; bone trabecula at upper left
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows increased megakaryocytes forming loose clusters, with hyperchromatic, irregular and clumped nuclei. The megakaryocytes lie within a fibrotic stroma showing streaming of spindle and hematopoietic cells, with granulocytic cells, inconspicuous erythroid islands, focal hemorrhage and hemosiderin. Reticulin/trichrome staining is needed to grade fibrosis. In a patient with polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps completely; distinction requires a prior diagnosis of PV.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow fibrosis (e.g., infection, autoimmune myelofibrosis)
ddx.vs: Reactive fibrosis lacks clustered atypical hyperchromatic megakaryocytes and shows polyclonal lymphoid aggregates without a driver mutation.
Metastatic tumor shows cohesive nests of keratin-positive cells rather than megakaryocytes in the fibrotic stroma.
